uncited: **Ray Intersection:** For each pixel, a camera ray is cast.

**Radiance Estimation:** The radiance is estimated using the gathered beams, applying the standard photon density estimation formula from the parent [Parent](2521-photon-based-estimation.md), using the power and phase function of the intersected beams.
*   **High Overlap:** Naive BVH application is inefficient when many beams overlap the same region (e.g., from a point light).
The BVH construction uses the Surface Area Heuristic [MacDonald and Booth 1990].
